description: Saves contractor labour rates to the SHARED database for the country (per unit: m2, door, point, stage) so prepare_plan can price stages right away. Save what you found on rate sites (url of the page with the rate). Never rates the user only told you. Implausible rates come back in rejected.

unit.description: m2 — per m² of working surface (painting/skimming — walls+ceiling, bathroom — wall+floor tiles, floors — floor), door — per door, point — per electrical point, stage — for the whole stage

name: save_labor_rates
title: Save labour rates
